inputs.name: ReportCommand.run.argv
inputs.description: The argument list passed to the report CLI: argv[0] names the operation (begin, record, finalize, import, serve, stop, cleanup or sync-storage), and the other items are options that Node's parseArgs reads, where historical and dry-run are switches and every other option takes a value. An empty array or an unrecognized first item makes run reject with the usage error.

outputs.name: ReportCommand.run
outputs.description: The promise that run returns from ReportCommandService.execute, resolving to the result of the operation named in argv[0]: a Report for begin, record and finalize; { run, ...result } for import, where result is the import path's own return value ({ records } for manual, { checks: 1 } for command); { port, reused, url, pid } for serve; a stop result for stop; and a retention or storage-sync summary for cleanup and sync-storage. Failures on individual reports during cleanup and sync-storage go into their errors arrays rather than rejecting, and stop resolves with stopped set to false when no server is recorded on the port or the recorded one had already ended.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with 'Usage: report <begin|record|finalize|import|serve|stop|cleanup|sync-storage> [options]' when argv[0] is not one of the eight operations, including when argv is empty.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with '--<name> is required' when a flag the operation needs (run, kind, project, title, mode, environment, format or file) is missing, blank, or given without a value.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with 'Provide --data JSON or --file JSON' when record has neither a --data value nor non-empty --file content.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with 'Project, title and valid mode are required' when begin's --mode is neither feature nor suite.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with 'Unsupported record kind' when record's --kind is not check, evidence, finding, coverage, acceptance, summary or heartbeat.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with 'Record data is required' when the --data or --file content of a record is not a JSON object, such as null, a primitive or an array.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with a record field message ('Record title is required', 'Summary text is required', 'Acceptance criteria must be a list of short nonempty strings', 'Valid status is required', 'Invalid evidence status', 'Evidence path is required', 'Invalid evidence phase', 'Invalid audio duration' or 'Invalid audio transcript') when a record's fields fail the checks for its kind.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with 'Invalid report or asset ID' when --run, or the data.id of a check, finding, coverage or evidence record, is not 1 to 100 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with 'Invalid report directory' when the --run report directory is a symbolic link, with a filesystem ENOENT error when no report exists for --run, and with a filesystem error or SyntaxError when its manifest.json is missing or not valid JSON.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with 'Cannot update finalizing or finalized report' when record targets a run whose state is not active.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with 'Report is already finalized' when finalize targets a run that is already finalized.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with 'Report must be finalizing' when finalize's second step finds the run in another state, which happens when another call has changed the run between the two steps.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with a Node filesystem error from mkdir, writeFile or rename when begin cannot create the run directory or write manifest.json.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with a Node filesystem error, such as ENOENT, from readFile when a record --file, or an import file for a format other than playwright, vitest or mira, cannot be read.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: Rejects when JSON the operation parses is invalid: --acceptance for begin, --data or --file content for record, or the import file for a format other than playwright, vitest or mira.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with 'Unsupported import format' when import has a --run and a format other than playwright, vitest, mira, manual or command, after the file has been read and parsed.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with '--run is required for this import format' when import has no --run and its format is not mira.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with 'Manual import must contain records' when a manual import file is neither an array nor an object with a records array.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with 'Command outcome must be an object' when a command import file is a JSON array.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with 'Command exitCode is required' when Number(exitCode) of a command import file is not an integer, for example when exitCode is missing.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Rejects with a TypeError when a manual or command import file parses to JSON null, or when a manual import contains a null record or an evidence record without a data object.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with 'No available loopback port from preferred range' when serve finds all 30 ports from the preferred port (5588 by default) occupied or answering as another server.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with 'Report server failed to start on port <port>' when a started server does not report the matching identity within 40 checks spaced 250 ms apart.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: Rejects when the recorded-server file that serve (when reusing a server) or stop reads is not valid JSON.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with a Node error, such as code ESRCH, from process.kill in stop when the recorded server exits between the liveness check and the signal.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with 'Invalid report cleanup root' when cleanup finds the report root, or its runs, publications or retention-lock folder, to be a symbolic link.
